audit_items.proof_trace: Block verification enforces commitments.len() <= max_blobs_per_block(epoch) at L885. Data column verification lacks this epoch-specific check—it only validates SSZ bounds (U4096), allowing attackers to send data columns with commitments exceeding the epoch's max_blobs_per_block (6/9/schedule).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends data column sidecar over P2P gossip with kzg_commitments.len() = 10 during Deneb epoch (max=6). Passes verify_data_column_sidecar, propagates network-wide, causes nodes to process oversized columns, potential DoS or state inconsistency.
